answer: A payout is split so that 32% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The atlas schedule is applied in saffron and jetty shows each instalment. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3471 identities would post 2409 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
